sloka: पम्पा तीर रुहान् वृक्षान् वीक्षमाणौ समंततः ।इमाम् नदीम् शुभ जलाम् शोभयन्तौ तरस्विनौ ॥४-३-७॥
transliteration: pampā tīra ruhān vṛkṣān vīkṣamāṇau samaṁtataḥ ।imām nadīm śubha jalām śobhayantau tarasvinau ॥4-3-7॥

translations.english: 'Gazing at the trees on the bank of Pampa, you both appear in brilliant complexion as if to enhance the beauty of the auspicious river water. Though young, courageous and with handsome shoulders, you seem to sigh in exhaustion. And though you look like ascetics robed in bark, you seem to terrify these creatures.
translations.hindi: श्रीराम और लक्ष्मण दोनों भाई पूज्य जनों में अग्रणी हैँ आर आपसे मित्रता करना चाहते हैं। अतः इनको ग्रहण कर इनका सस्कार कीजिए
